functions.name: repository_clone_traffic
functions.description: Current rolling 14-day clone traffic window per repository and requested day/week aggregation. Window unique counts are not additive across repositories or overlapping retrievals; they are never calculated by summing bucket uniques. Bucket timestamps start at UTC midnight; weeks start Monday. This is one current observation per retrieval, not an append-only historical window identity.
